newsitem.title: UK: UK's FTSE 100 opens firm after Dow's advance.
newsitem.headline: UK's FTSE 100 opens firm after Dow's advance.

text.p: The UK's FTSE 100 index opened in high spirits on Wednesday, taking its cue from an encouraging performance in New York despite the release of disappointing half-year earnings from two major FTSE companies.
A firmer opening for the index futures fuelled initial gains, sending the lead index up 30.4 points or 0.6 percent to 4,907 by 0740 GMT. Only eight stocks were in decline.
FTSE futures opened at a premium to fair value, estimated around 20 points, but smaller stocks were once again left behind. The Mid-250 was up just 1.2 points at 4,461.9.
